en-US.title: Opnshelf
en-US.subtitle: Movies, shows & watchlists
en-US.description:
Opnshelf is your home for movies and TV. Keep track of what you have watched, what you want to see, and what is coming up next — without losing the moments and opinions that made each title memorable.

- Build a watchlist for movies and shows
- Track seasons, episodes, and release dates
- Rate titles and write reviews
- Create lists for every mood and occasion
- See what friends are watching and recommending
- Import your Trakt history to get started quickly

Your shelf is personal, social, and portable. Opnshelf is built on an open network, so your identity and media history are not locked to one app.
